text.en: Clients commend Dr Petersen and Dr Garfield alongside veterinary technicians for their in-depth knowledge and compassionate approach when managing chronic skin conditions. Pet owners value detailed anatomical explanations and supportive guidance through complex diagnoses. Although one telephone enquiry reported an unhelpful receptionist, the medical team is widely praised.

Reviewers report successful clinical results for intractable ear polyps, canine pemphigus, severe allergies, and recurrent skin disorders. Pet parents express relief that targeted treatments and surgical referrals restored quality of life after years of unresolved discomfort, noting that therapies remain effective even when requiring significant commitment.

Pet owners appreciate the genuine empathy shown towards chronically uncomfortable dogs and cats during lengthy dermatologic consultations on Trinity Mills Road. Reviewers note that specialists take considerable trouble to understand each animal's history, tailoring oral drops and allergy therapies to minimize pet stress and trauma.

q.en: What skin conditions are treated at the clinic?

a.en: The practice treats acute and chronic canine and feline skin allergies, ear polyps, pemphigus, and autoimmune disorders.

q.en: Are consultations arranged on a referral basis?

a.en: Yes, appointments typically involve specialist veterinary referrals and advance scheduling.

q.en: Do appointments require extended waiting times?

a.en: Several reviewers note that thorough diagnostic examinations often take between an hour and two hours.

q.en: Are alternative allergy treatments available for pets?

a.en: Yes, clients mention choices between allergy injections and sublingual oral drops depending on pet tolerance.
